Container.Name: kb-learn
Container.Overview: The kb's nightly learning pass: re-analyzes stored video transcripts through kb-litellm and writes the result to the library database. Ships off until it is enabled with a budget. Runs only while the host's role file says active. STARTED IN ORDER: after kb-service. NETWORK: set the Network field to kb. No port, no data volume; mount the host's facts folder read-only at /facts.
Container.Description: Nightly learning pass for the knowledge library (kb-service image, python -m kb_service.learn). Start after kb-service.

Config.Name: Facts
Config.Description: REQUIRED. This host's facts folder, read-only: the folder holding the role file (kb_role) and the maintenance flag (maintenance.until). Mount the folder, not the files: the role file is replaced by a rename. Set per host.

Config.Name: KB_DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The same PostgreSQL URL and role as kb-service, format postgresql://<user>:<password>@kb-postgres:5432/<db>. kb-service applies the migrations. Blank: the container exits 2.

Config.Name: LITELLM_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Base URL of the model router: the kb-litellm container on the kb network. Leave the default.

Config.Name: LITELLM_KEY
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Key for kb-litellm; it must allow the model group below. Blank: the container exits 2.

Config.Name: KB_LEARN_MODEL
Config.Description: kb-litellm model group for the re-analysis; its nightly cap lives in kb-litellm's config. Blank means kb-learning.

Config.Name: KB_LEARN_WORKERS
Config.Description: Items analyzed at once, 1 to 3; anything else makes the container exit 2. Blank means 2.

Config.Name: KB_EMBED_BASE_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Embedding endpoint, as kb-service. Blank: the container exits 2.

Config.Name: KB_EMBED_MODEL
Config.Description: Embedding model name as kb-litellm lists it, as kb-service. Blank: qwen3-embedding:0.6b.

Config.Name: KB_EMBED_API_KEY
Config.Description: Key for the embedding endpoint, as kb-service. Blank if the endpoint takes none.

Config.Name: KB_ROLES
Config.Default: {"PM": "pm", "System Admin": "system-admin", "Network Admin": "network-admin", "Backup Admin": "backup-admin", "Media Admin": "media-admin", "Game Dev": "game-dev", "KB Analyst": "kb-analyst", "Financial Analyst": "financial-analyst", "Travel Planner": "travel-planner"}
Config.Description: The messaging roles, the same value as kb-service's KB_ROLES. The morning report goes to the role KB Analyst; blank sends no report. Malformed JSON makes the container exit 2.

Container.Config: {"PM": "pm", "System Admin": "system-admin", "Network Admin": "network-admin", "Backup Admin": "backup-admin", "Media Admin": "media-admin", "Game Dev": "game-dev", "KB Analyst": "kb-analyst", "Financial Analyst": "financial-analyst", "Travel Planner": "travel-planner"}

Config.Name: KB_LEARN_ROLE_FILE
Config.Description: The host's role file inside the container. The pass runs only while it says active and is under 15 minutes old. Leave the default: it is under the Facts mount.

Config.Name: KB_LEARN_MAINT_FILE
Config.Description: The host's maintenance flag inside the container (a UTC end time); the pass does not run before it. Leave the default: it is under the Facts mount.

Config.Name: KB_LEARN_SERVICE_URL
Config.Description: kb-service on this host; the pass runs only while its /health answers. Leave the default.

Config.Name: KB_LEARN_STOP_FILE
Config.Description: A hand stop: while this file exists inside the container the pass starts nothing new (docker exec kb-learn touch it). Blank means /tmp/kb-learn.stop.
